# Vendored browser dependency

- Anime.js 4.5.0, MIT license.
- Source: https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime/tree/v4.5.0
- `anime.umd.min.js` is the unmodified upstream `dist/bundles/anime.umd.min.js`.
- `anime.LICENSE.md` is the upstream `LICENSE.md`.
- Served locally to keep the existing Content Security Policy and avoid runtime CDN requests.
- Used for login/announcement animation and cross-parent layout transitions. No build step is required.
- SHA-256 of `anime.umd.min.js`: `8d5b3a58a1f64023a04a4cedeef135a2263b18da04b35177ac13438a0bad033b`.
